¿Qué es el arte digital? 🌐      Cuando hablamos de arte digital la tecnología no tiene que ser el único medio de creación, con el simple hecho de que haya una intervención tecnológica, o algún elemento añadido con el ordenador, la pieza es considerada digital. Esta forma de arte puede ser generada totalmente por una computadora, escaneada, dibujada o editada utilizando un mouse o una tableta.        El arte es, pues, ante todo, experiencia. Sensaciones como resultado de pensamientos compartidos, que juntos conforman experiencias. Want to create and sell digital products? Here's what you actually do. 👇  1. Start with a problem. What problem are you solving for someone else? The best digital products make something easier, faster, or less overwhelming. 2. Create the solution. Turn what you know into something useful—a guide, checklist, planner, workbook, template, printable, mini-course, or resource. 3. Choose where to sell it. You can sell digital products through platforms like Etsy, Teachers Pay Teachers, Stan Store, or your own website. Choose the platform that makes sense for your product and audience. You can also publish them on Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing or Google Play.  4. Market it. Creating the product is only HALF the job. People have to find it! Use Pinterest, TikTok,  email, a blog, or search-friendly content to show people how your product solves their problem. 5. Learn from the first one...then create another. Your first product doesn't have to build financial freedom. It's your starting point. Create one useful product. Learn how to sell it. Improve. Then create another. Over time, you can build a collection of digital products that can be purchased while you're teaching, spending time with family, or simply living your life.  That's what I love about learning skills that can create income from home. I'm not looking for another job. I'm building more ways to earn—and more choices for my future. Financial freedom doesn't have to start with something huge. It can start with one product that solves one problem.
